title: [CTW] Road

replies.author: _DISTRACTION_
replies.body:
The layout is interesting; here are my thoughts:
  • The wool rooms are too difficult to get into, since they are so close to spawn.
  • Each side's lanes should be less flat, and maybe should move further way from each other.
  • The middle area may need changes based on gameplay.

replies.author: Riilo
replies.body:
I agree with _DISTRACTION_

Wool rooms are quite hard to get to, considering they have to run past spawn. Mid is quite small and can barely hold more than 5 people. Also, the diamonds at mid probably won't work considering the people who get the diamonds can just camp the wool and kill any leather person that attacks them. I would add iron, and fix the issues stated above. It is a great start though and like the clay idea!

The wool room should be fine unless theres like a big defense or somehing making it harder to access. I wouldnt really care about the wool rooms as I like stalemate maps.

The shape looks interesting and unique and I think it'd be playung well with a not too high player count.

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Nice concept! But I have to agree with what the previous posts have pointed out.
Getting to the wool rooms would be tremendously difficult considering the uneven terrain that the curve-y road has, and moreover, it is too close to spawn for it to offer the opposing teams a fair chance of success
The middle area though, it seems a little out of place considering how the rest of the map was built, I suggest editing it to make it bigger and maybe pushing the four main areas of the map back a little to offer more space to players

I must note out however that I like the shape of it (if we exclude the aforementioned map section, haha) and it looks like it would be very fun to play on. Carry on!
